headline: Chip designer Marvell raised its revenue target for its 2028 fiscal year to about $20 billion, and its shares jumped.
score_reason: Company guidance reported by Reuters and confirmed by a second outlet; the event is dated 6 Oct 2026, so no reduction.
importance_line: Investors and AI data center builders get a fresh sign that spending on custom AI chips and networking is still rising, but the figures are the company's own targets, not results.
summary: Reuters reports, as relayed by The Economic Times, that Marvell Technology, which makes custom AI chips and data center networking gear, lifted its forecast for fiscal 2028 revenue to around $20 billion from $18 billion given in August, and its shares rose nearly 9% in early trading. The Motley Fool, covering the same investor day, adds that the stock closed up 5.81% and that the company set a fiscal 2031 sales target of $70 billion to $90 billion; both are management targets, not results.
notes: Original Reuters page blocked; facts from the Economic Times (Reuters text) and Motley Fool.
